_comment: Selection policy for the railway provider build. Every generated query, response schema and request body derives from the pinned schema through these settings; change the policy, never the generated artifacts.

expandNested._comment: Type.field entries whose nested object is selected one level deeper than nestedDepth, because the value objects beneath it carry the data the resource exists for.

unstableFields._comment: Fields observed to fail for an ordinary account token. The engine fails the whole statement on any GraphQL error, so these are not selected. Type -> field -> observation (make validate-live is the evidence).

User.platformFeatureFlags: 2026-09-28: me.platformFeatureFlags answers Not Authorized for an account token on the Hobby plan

Variable.plugin: 2026-09-28: Environment.variables { plugin { ... } } answers "Problem processing request" (plugins are a retired concept; the non-null resolver fails for service variables)
Variable.service: 2026-09-28: Environment.variables { service { ... } } answers "Problem processing request" when the environment holds a shared variable (no service; the field is declared non-null); service_id carries the reference

EnvironmentPatch.environment: 2026-09-28: environmentStagedChanges { environment { ... } } answers "Problem processing request" (the staged patch is synthetic, id "<empty>"); environment_id carries the reference

Project.members: 2026-09-28: projects(includeDeleted: true) { members } answers Project not found for every deleted project; the project_members resource serves the list
Project.workspace: 2026-09-28: projects(includeDeleted: true) { workspace } answers Project not found for every deleted project; workspace_id carries the reference
